rule.primary: total computed tokens (prompt_tokens - cached_tokens summed over every request of the replay), lower is better
rule.secondary: cohort tenants' cached_tokens on their returns (return and final requests), stated always
rule.win: a policy wins only if it is better on the primary at every pair in both orders; a tie at any pair is not better; otherwise inconclusive
rule.precondition: every completion digest identical across arms, runs and the cache-off boot
